GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to lead Two Wide by just over a length settling down, crossed at 1500m, Home Track up front until Headed 600m, trailed a half length turning, dropped right out in straight. (Winkers FIRST TIME) [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it travelled comfortably to 800m however failed to respond and was disappointing. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr stated gelding travelled comfortably to the 800m, however failed to respond to riding and was disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Lost the offside hind plate.

Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down 1/2 Lengths Clear Collared x 1st x 400m Couldn'T Go On (t/t/off) # led, no fight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced in restricted room for a short distance near the 250m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , trapped 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 3 Lengths 800m, eventually got outside leader, Ridden Along soon after Straightening Up and weakened off tough run, blinkers off first time # weakened 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount raced keen early. Whilst over-racing, eased near 1100m when close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled in second half 3 Wide With Cover 7 Lengths 800m, still well off them between runners Straightening Up , got going late but never close, Blinkers First Time # Never Likely

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 1300m, was taken in slightly. Bumped and carried wider near the 500m. Eased down from the 300m. Rdr reported after receiving some pressure and being hampered near the 500m, mare failed to feel entirely comfortable and was eased down. A post-race vet exam revealed lameness in right hind leg. Vet cert prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly . Pushed fwd & shared lead keenly Two Wide before raced 2nd Two Wide (1L from lead) early Held Ground until pushed to hold ground @ 500m. Struggling @ 400m & gave ground from home turn. # On-pace/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over raced when the pace of the race slackened near the 1200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a head, Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, sole Lead mid-turn, Headed Straightening Up and lost a little ground in Straight # weakened in str.

Jumped Ok , sat 4th Two Wide behind Fast Pace 3 Lengths 800m, was losing ground before the corner and looked to have gone amiss, eased down in Straight , Vet revealed no abnormalities # eased down turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped when marginally crowded near the 1100m. Shifted out and bumped near the 1000m. Bumped and forced in near the 900m before shifting out and bumping again. Momentarily steadied from heels when weakening near the 600m. Eased down in the home straight. Underwent a post-race veterinary examination which revealed no obvious abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward on-pace oppo Took sit 4th 1x1 3 Lengths , enjoyed good trail out 3 Wide x 500m Under Pressure clear run home couldn't quicken Couldn'T Go On @ 200m, # Just Battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Tongue tie adjusted at gates. Steadied from heels and shifted wider near the 1200m. Laid in passing the 200m despite the efforts of its rider. Rdr reported gelding raced flat. A post-race vet exam failed to reveal any abs.
